name: International Workshop on Spoken Language Translation (IWSLT) datasets
description: A collection of multilingual speech translation and machine translation evaluation datasets released for the annual IWSLT shared tasks.
citation: Cettolo, M., Niehues, J., Stüker, S., Bentivogli, L., & Federico, M. (2015). The IWSLT 2015 Evaluation Campaign. Proceedings of the 12th International Workshop on Spoken Language Translation (IWSLT 2015).

license.identifier: IWSLT dataset terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
